scope: Fictional checklist completion and evidence selection; validation pilot.
limitations: One small model and one seed; all cases share one synthetic generator.
Rule correctness is a narrow proxy, not measured professional quality.
No demonstration of autonomous self-reflection or recursive optimization.
Context pairs and cases within a scenario family are not independent observations.
The earlier pilot changed both prompting and training budget; v2 does not isolate those changes.

hash_conventions.prompt_sha256: Record hash of the rendered native-chat prompt string

timing_notes.process_seconds: Entire subprocess, including startup, loading and saving.
timing_notes.preparation_seconds: Dependency imports, model loading and trainer initialization.
timing_notes.reference_precompute_seconds: Subset of preparation; do not add it a second time.
timing_notes.train_seconds: trainer.train wall time; excludes preparation and adapter saving.
timing_notes.total_seconds: Training function through adapter saving; excludes process startup.
timing_notes.evaluation_seconds: Rendering, generation, scoring, prediction writes and summary; excludes model loading.

objective.reference: frozen instruction base; independent of SFT
